name: MC-Search
description: MC-Search is a benchmark for evaluating multimodal agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with structured reasoning chains. It provides hop-wise reasoning chains specifying sub-questions, retrieval modalities, supporting facts, and intermediate answers to assess retrieval planning and reasoning accuracy.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with limited but growing adoption in multimodal RAG and agentic retrieval studies, mainly used in academic evaluations rather than broad industry leaderboards.
notes: Includes a hop-wise verification procedure (HAVE) to filter hallucinated or redundant steps; covers five reasoning structures.
